Step-by-Step Application Instructions

Follow these 6 numbered steps for seamless, natural grey hair coverage in just 10 minutes:

  1. Step 1: Safety Patch Test & Beard Prep

    Perform a 48-hour allergy patch test on the inner forearm or behind your ear. Ensure your beard is completely clean, dry, and free of beard oils, balms, or wax prior to application.

  2. Step 2: Dispense & Mix 1:1 Ratio

    Squeeze equal quantities of 001 Natural Black Colourant Cream and Developer Cream into the provided mixing tray. Blend thoroughly with the applicator brush until you achieve a smooth, uniform cream.

  3. Step 3: Target Grey Zones First

    Using the brush side of the applicator, apply the mixture directly to the areas with the most concentrated grey whiskers—typically the chin, lower jawline, and sideburns.

  4. Step 4: Comb Through for Full Uniformity

    Flip to the fine-tooth comb side and gently distribute the cream through the mustache and full beard, ensuring every bristle is coated from root to tip.

  5. Step 5: 10-Minute Development Timer

    Allow the cream to develop for exactly 10 minutes. Avoid touching or rubbing your beard during processing while the micro-pigments lock into hair keratin.

  6. Step 6: Rinse with Lukewarm Water

    Rinse your beard thoroughly with lukewarm water until the water runs completely clear. Gently pat dry with a dark towel. Enjoy your refreshed, natural black beard.

Application Advisory: Always follow the application instructions and recommended development time provided on the product packaging.

Precautions & 48-Hour Patch Test Protocol

Read and follow all safety precautions to safeguard your facial skin:

Mandatory 48-Hour Allergy Patch Test Protocol

  1. Cleanse a small 1 cm² patch of skin behind your ear or on the inside crook of your elbow using mild soap and water.
  2. Mix a pea-sized drop of Colourant Cream (001 Natural Black) with an equal drop of Developer Cream in a small non-metallic dish.
  3. Apply the mixture thinly to the test area and leave undisturbed for 48 hours without washing or covering.
  4. If any redness, swelling, burning, itching, or skin eruption occurs, do not use the product on your facial hair.

Important Safety Warnings

  • Do not use this product if you have experienced previous adverse reactions to hair or beard colourants.
  • Do not apply if facial skin has active eczema, sunburn, razor burns, open cuts, or severe acne.
  • Avoid all contact with eyes. If cream accidentally enters the eye, flush immediately with copious clean water and seek medical advice.
  • This product is formulated exclusively for facial hair (beards, moustaches, and sideburns). Do not use to dye eyelashes or eyebrows, as this may cause blindness.
  • Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct heat and sunlight.

Frequently Asked Questions: Natural Black

Detailed answers to common questions about Dailyfix Natural Black beard colour:

Q: Will Dailyfix 001 Natural Black look like shoe polish or fake hair dye?

A: No. Traditional black dyes often impart an unnatural bluish-purple sheen or flat, ink-like density. Dailyfix 001 Natural Black is engineered with nuanced micro-pigments that match natural human melanin, delivering an authentic, undetectable finish with natural hair luster.

Q: How long does Dailyfix Natural Black Beard Colour last on coarse grey facial hair?

A: The colour remains rich and vibrant for 3 to 4 weeks, depending on your beard growth rate and daily washing frequency. Because it bonds directly with facial hair keratin, it does not wash out with water or regular beard shampoo.

Q: Is Dailyfix 001 Natural Black 100% ammonia-free?

A: Yes, Dailyfix 001 Natural Black Beard Colour is completely 100% ammonia-free. It produces zero pungent fumes, prevents stinging or burning around sensitive mustache areas, and respects the delicate lipid barrier of your facial skin.

Q: Will this Natural Black beard colour stain my skin or cheeks during application?

A: The rich, non-drip cream consistency is formulated to adhere strictly to coarse facial hair strands rather than the underlying skin. As long as stray cream is wiped off promptly with a damp cloth, it leaves your cheek and neck margins perfectly clean without dark residue.

Q: Can I use Dailyfix Natural Black on my moustache and sideburns?

A: Yes. The included dual-sided applicator comb is specially designed with a fine-bristle side to navigate narrow areas like the philtrum, upper lip moustache line, and sideburns without mess.

Q: Why is the 48-hour patch test mandatory even if I have dyed my beard before?

A: Skin sensitivity can fluctuate over time due to stress, environmental changes, or seasonal factors. Conducting a simple 48-hour patch test before each application ensures your facial skin remains comfortable, protected, and free of adverse reactions.

Q: How many applications can I get from one pack of 001 Natural Black?

A: Depending on your beard density and length, a single pack provides 2 to 3 full facial hair applications. The resealable cream tubes allow you to dispense only the exact amount you need for touch-ups.
